content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Wichita

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and credential thresholds for your background. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can clarify whether your experience meets the standard, ensuring you're ready to enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, on a schedule that fits your job in aerospace, defense, healthcare, or another Wichita industry. Our active certified practitioners deliver real-world case studies and exam-aligned content across the five process groups.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, create your PMI account and submit your formal PMP® application, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the examination fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy guides you through each requirement so your application is complete and on schedule.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and final review sessions to build confidence. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center or online. You'll take a four-hour, multiple-choice exam that assesses your mastery of project-management domains and situational judgment.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After you pass, you'll hold the PMP® mark for three years. During this cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) by attending training, conferences, or completing approved project-management activities. Renew before expiration to keep your credential active and demonstrate ongoing expertise to employers in your local market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
